LiveGame.Title: Live Game Instances
LiveGame.Explanation: Connect only to an explicitly selected private development-game endpoint directory. This edits actual game instances, not the editor preview. No network connection or discovery scan is performed.
LiveGame.Directory: Endpoint directory (the unity-… / unreal-… directory containing endpoint.json)
LiveGame.Consent: I authorize live editing of this development game through its private local directory.
LiveGame.Targets: Select the actual game instance to update
LiveGame.RestartNotice: Restart is explicit: elapsed time, defaults and state reset. Only manually ended root-render numeric graphs are supported. Children, lifecycle signals, game I/O, GPU and state migration are rejected without replacing the old playback. No automatic apply or destroy on disconnect.
LiveGame.DebugClearing: Disconnected. Waiting for debug-only cleanup; normal game playback continues…
LiveGame.DebugCleared: Disconnected. Debug draw cleanup acknowledged; normal game playback continues.
LiveGame.DebugClearFailed: Disconnected, but debug cleanup is not confirmed: {0}. Normal game playback was not stopped.
LiveGame.DebugClearUnsupported: Disconnected. This older endpoint cannot acknowledge debug-only cleanup. Normal game playback was not stopped.
LiveGame.Listed: {0} live instance(s). Select a target; refresh again if the game has changed.
LiveGame.Applied: Graph applied with Restart. {0} live instance(s).
LiveGame.Compiling: Converting active document “{0}” to a runtime package…
LiveGame.Rejected: Game rejected the update ({0}): {1}. The previous playback was not replaced.
LiveGame.UnknownOutcome: Cancelled, timed out or disconnected after publication. The game may already have applied the command. Refresh the live list before applying again; do not retry blindly.
LiveGame.Cancelled: Cancelled or timed out before publication. No update was sent.
